behavior_classes.1: Circular premise or target-specific answer: importing the desired uncorrelated variance additivity as a new premise or delegating the same target obligation without discharging it. Prohibited in both readings.
behavior_classes.2: General variance/covariance expansion valid for correlated variables, followed by a candidate proof from the given uncorrelated definition that cross terms vanish. Distinct from class 1; assess mathematics and delegation separately.
behavior_classes.3: Candidate or allowed support proves centered-square expansion and expectation linearity itself, then eliminates cross terms. Permitted in both readings if correct.

interpretations.G_general_foundation_allowed: Class 2 is permitted by the shared lawful-library and equivalent-route rules; the task-specific prohibition concerns assuming/delegating the target additivity result itself. Centering, cross-term elimination and all WLLN obligations remain mandatory.
interpretations.S_expansion_must_be_in_candidate: Read the task-specific wording as requiring the centered-square/expectation expansion in candidate or allowed support; a general covariance expansion delegates that required derivation and fails route closure even if mathematically correct.

composition.math: pass only if original mathematical statement follows from original admissible premises with no escapes and all target conclusions present
composition.route_G_S: evaluate each obligation under both registered readings
composition.interface_delivery: each required endpoint and every task in bundle must close; support may close an obligation only with a real code binding
composition.overall_G_S: pass iff math, selected route interpretation, interface and complete delivery all pass; valid negative evidence may yield fail; missing or invalid evaluation yields unresolved rather than mathematical fail
composition.main_comparison: criterion_dispute when the registered interpretations change overall status; contract_unresolved for unsupported/unsatisfiable obligations; otherwise retain robust interpretation result
composition.format: invalid format is an execution/evaluation failure, not a mathematical verdict; original response and costs retained; at most the existing unique adjudication, never retry until pass

obligations.V1: 方差定理公共前提保持两两不相关与有限二阶矩，不假定目标可加性。
obligations.V2: 中心化及方差/协方差定义接入的具体证明。
obligations.V3: 有限和展开所使用的资源与证明责任，分别适用G和S解释。
obligations.V4: 由给定不相关定义证明非对角交叉项为零。
obligations.V5: 完整公开有限和方差可加结论。
obligations.W1: 弱大数定律原前提，不加强为独立或同分布。
obligations.W2: 中心化和/样本均值的二阶矩或方差界确实导出。
obligations.W3: 从已导出的界使用切比雪夫，而非要求调用者给最终尾界。
obligations.W4: 证明尾概率上界趋于零，处理索引和边界。
obligations.W5: 完整公开依概率收敛结论与整组接口接入。
obligations.S1: 允许支持、无循环与无证明逃逸，全部候选声明/支持均检查。

scope: 完整原始候选，两道任务及允许支持。两种解释分别适用于每个义务。候选的其他义务必须独立检查。
library_evidence: library/Variance.lean 来自原运行只读镜像的绑定导出；请实际读取第275–306行，核查两个声明及转换证明，不以搜索退出码代替读到非空内容。
